integrity: Analytical proof and independently recomputed exact-rational finite checks are supplied. No external or independent mathematical audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The proof assumes unit-weighted complete graphs with vertex-disjoint missing edges and uses the inherited Euclidean zero-sum metric. The second-order law assumes convergence of the removed-edge density. Finite exact computations do not independently prove the all-order theorem. Historical priority is provisional.
title: An angular fingerprint and a two-scale dihedral law for matching-deleted Laplacian simplices
